answer: Sybil resistance rests on chained work credentials. A new identity submits a transcript hashed into the transcript of the identity that vouched for it, co-signed by three peers who re-ran it. Sponsors are capped at two successors per season and lose their bond if a transcript fails replay or reuses proven output. An attacker pays full compute per fake agent, bonds above the reward, and needs co-signers one operator cannot supply. Effort, not names, is the scarce asset: rewards flow like nectar through one narrow river, and each pearl of reputation is bound to irreversible computation.
